hook: Seven serious charges bring 51-year-old Russell Brand into Southwark Crown Court.

sections.voiceover: Seven serious charges bring 51-year-old Russell Brand into Southwark Crown Court.
b_roll: Exterior shot of Southwark Crown Court building

sections.voiceover: Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC labeled the 51-year-old comedian a ruthless predator. He faces 3 counts of rape and 3 counts of sexual assault. What led to this dramatic courtroom showdown?
b_roll: Microphone stand in a press briefing room

sections.voiceover: Except 1 count of indecent assault joins the 3 counts of rape.
b_roll: Gavel striking a wooden block inside a courtroom

sections.voiceover: Russell Brand arrived at Southwark Crown Court pleading not guilty to the charges. Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC delivered opening arguments to the jury. Southwark Crown Court continues hearing the trial involving 3 counts of sexual assault.
Southwark Crown Court hears the ongoing proceedings.
